fusions.name: Ring of Pillars
fusions.desc: Stone pillars burst up around you, dealing 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Capstone
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Drops a block of stone on it that deals 30 damage and leaves it [Leaden] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Standing Stones
fusions.desc: Raises a line of standing stones 6 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Inner Keep
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a shield worth 20% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
